sanitizer.leak_detection_reason: Target allocates no memory; LeakSanitizer cannot inspect this ptrace-based runner.

scope: Actual src/local_api.c and src/local_store.c run unchanged against fake flash, clock, and control boundaries.
Recipe CRUD, 15-step boundary, 16-record capacity, stable IDs, slot reuse, reboot persistence and front-panel recipe loading.
Every short-write boundary in 489-byte recipe and 432-byte catalog records tested after a valid commit, then rebooted.
Retained-tail partial overwrites accept only the old or complete valid new committed recipe. A write error can be commit-uncertain; clients must read before retrying.
Storage read/stat failures fail closed; malformed catalog is preserved, never silently reset to empty.
Strict bounded JSON, invalid/duplicate fields and unsafe paths, shared input/output arena, settings rollback and persistent local session counters.
Controller command dispatch, missing recipe prevalidation, busy recipe/settings mutation rejection, stop/clear-stop results and virtual encoder validation.
Status/readiness, display framebuffer encoding, eight-entry volatile event ring and reboot behavior.

openapi.validation_method: JSON parse/local-reference checks plus representative request/response payloads checked with jsonschema Draft4 after OpenAPI nullable conversion. No separate full OpenAPI meta-schema validator was installed.

limitations: No physical appliance, power-cut hardware test, SLFS wear test, network timing measurement, thermal behavior or native transport validation is claimed by this suite.
Controller is stubbed here; safe-stop and scheduling behavior require the separate controller tests and hardware validation.
First-ever torn catalog initialization without any valid bank fails closed for recovery.
Events are RAM-only; persistent recipe/settings/session-sequence records are not full session history or durable telemetry.
No dedicated program pause/resume API; front-panel encoder/menu flow provides existing prompts and controls.
